findings.criterion: AC1: `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` tells plan authors to assert the mechanism gate's exit code (or 'exits 0' / 'no unadmitted new mechanism'), names `new=N` as counting admitted entries, and states the measured fact that `origin/main` itself reports a nonzero `new`. `rebar explain plan` renders the new text.
findings.detail: The full body of `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` (321 lines) was read. It contains no mention of the mechanism gate's exit code, 'exits 0', 'unadmitted new mechanism', `new=N` counting admitted entries, or the measured fact that `origin/main` reports a nonzero `new`. None of the required content is present.

findings.criterion: AC2: The same guide tells plan authors that `make verify` excludes `integration`- and `external`-marked tests, and that an AC touching such a module must name the explicit command that runs it (`pytest <path> -m ""`) in addition to `make verify`.
findings.detail: The full body of `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` (321 lines) was read. It contains no mention of `make verify` excluding `integration`- or `external`-marked tests, no mention of `pytest <path> -m ""`, and no guidance about integration-marked modules requiring explicit test commands.

findings.criterion: AC3: `grep -n 'mechanism-ok\|new=' src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` and `grep -n 'integration' src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` each return at least one hit, and `make verify` is green.
findings.detail: Both grep commands would return zero hits. The guide contains no occurrences of 'mechanism-ok', 'new=', or 'integration'. The full 321-line file was read and searched; none of these strings appear.

findings.criterion: AC4: `AGENTS.md`'s mechanism-delta paragraph no longer asserts that the gate fails on a nonzero `new` counter. Binary check: `grep -c 'fails on any `new>0`' AGENTS.md` returns 0, and `grep -c 'exit' AGENTS.md` finds the replacement sentence.
findings.detail: AGENTS.md lines 381-382 still read: "and **fails on any `new>0`**". The incorrect text has not been removed or replaced. The binary check `grep -c 'fails on any \`new>0\`' AGENTS.md` would return 1, not 0. The real contract (exit code, marker-admitted entries) is not stated in that paragraph.

findings.criterion: Bug is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
findings.detail: Neither fix has been applied. AGENTS.md:381 still contains the incorrect 'fails on any `new>0`' text (Misread 1 root cause), and `writing-a-passing-plan.md` still has no guidance about the mechanism gate exit code or `make verify` excluding integration tests (Misread 2). Both reported defects still reproduce in the codebase.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
